severity_criteria.source_excerpt: protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria, Key Inclusion Criteria: "* Have \>20% to \<50% hair loss of the scalp, as measured by SALT." -- The eligibility text states greater than 20% and less than 50% scalp hair loss measured by SALT. These are separate bounds to preserve both strict comparators. The schema has no metric specifically named scalp hair loss percentage, so absolute_score with unit percent represents the stated SALT threshold without relabeling it as body-surface area.

value.dosing_interval: Once daily by mouth; treatment assignment may change after Week 24 based on response.
value.source_inconsistency: The brief summary describes 24 weeks of initial treatment plus another 23 weeks and an approximately 57-week study with a follow-up visit about 4 weeks after the last dose. The arm descriptions say treatment continues through Week 48, while the safety outcome timeframe extends up to Week 57. The source does not provide exact clinic or phone visit weeks, and the approximate follow-up anchor does not support assigning an absolute follow-up week.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: protocolSection.descriptionModule.briefSummary and protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.armGroups treatment descriptions: "They will take ritlecitinib or placebo once daily by mouth at home for 24 weeks (6 months)." "After 24 weeks, the assigned treatment may stay the same or be changed to ritlecitinib 50 mg or 100 mg." "Participants will receive the newly assigned treatment for another 23 weeks." "About 4 weeks after the last dose, there will be a follow-up visit." "Participants will take part in this study for about 57 weeks." "During this time, they will have study visits at the study clinic." "Participants will receive 1 ritlecitinib 50 mg capsule QD orally from Day 1 to Week 24." "Arm 1A (Ritlecitinib 50 mg R Group): 1 ritlecitinib 50 mg capsule QD and 1 placebo 100 mg capsule QD orally through Week 48." "Arm 1B (Ritlecitinib 50 mg NR→50 mg Group): 1 ritlecitinib 50 mg capsule QD and 1 placebo 100 mg capsule QD orally through Week 48." "Arm 1C (Ritlecitinib 50 mg NR→100 mg Group): 1 ritlecitinib 100 mg capsule QD and 1 placebo 50 mg capsule QD orally through Week 48." "Participants will receive 1 placebo 50 mg capsule QD orally from Day 1 to Week 24" "Arm 2A (Placebo R Group): 1 placebo 50 mg capsule QD and 1 placebo 100 mg capsule QD orally through Week 48." "Arm 2B (Placebo NR→Ritlecitinib 50 mg Group): 1 ritlecitinib 50 mg capsule QD and 1 placebo 100 mg capsule QD orally through Week 48." "Screening to Follow up period (up to week 57)" "Weeks 8, 12, 18 and 24" "Weeks 8, 12, 18" "Weeks 28, 36, and 48" -- The brief summary says study checks also occur by phone, but gives no contact weeks; these remain unspecified. The supplied CT.gov record contains no full visit table or visit cadence.
